session_5.text: Oh, c'mon. We'll have, we'll have a big party, and no-one'll know who's with who.

session_5.speaker: Bennett
session_5.text: Hey, y'know, this is so not what I needed right now.

session_5.speaker: Chloe
session_5.text: What's the matter?

session_5.speaker: Bennett
session_5.text: Oh, it's-it's Marcel. He keeps shutting me out, y'know? He's walking around all the time dragging his hands...

session_5.text: Really.

session_5.text: No.

session_5.text: Fiona. Hi.

session_5.text: Oh, hi Max! Hey, do you know everybody?

session_5.speaker: Max
session_5.text: No. Have you seen David?

session_5.text: No, no, he hasn't been around.

session_5.speaker: Max

session_5.speaker: Max
session_5.text: Minsk. It's in Russia.

session_5.text: I know where Minsk is.

session_5.text: We got the grant. Three years, all expenses paid.

session_5.speaker: Max
session_5.text: January first.

session_7.text: No. Okay. I was at the airport, getting into a cab, when this woman- this blonde planet with a pocketbook- starts yelling at me. Something about how it was her cab first. And then the next thing I know she just starts- starts pulling me out by my hair! So I'm blowing my attack whistle thingy and three more cabs show up, and as I'm going to get into a cab she tackles me. And I hit my head on the kerb and cut my lip on my whistle...oh...everybody having fun at the party?  Are people eating my dip?

session_7.text: Yeah.

session_7.speaker: Bennett

session_7.text: There you are! Haaah, you got away from me!

session_7.text: I'm sorry you misunderstood...

session_7.speaker: Janice
session_7.text: Oh my God. You listen to me, Dexter, you listen to me. One of these times is just gonna be your last chance with me.

session_7.text: Oh, will you give me the thing.

session_7.text: Hi, Max!

session_7.speaker: Max
session_7.text: Yoko.  I've decided to go to Minsk without you.

session_7.speaker: David
session_7.text: Wow.

session_7.text: It won't be the same- but it'll still be Minsk. Happy New Year.

session_7.text: Are you alright?

session_7.text: Yeah, I'm fine, I'm fine.

session_7.text: Oh yes, yes, yes you can. Just say, um, 'Fiona, my work is my life and that's what I have to do right now'. And I say 'your work?! Your work?! How can you say that?!'. And then you say, um, 'it's tearing me apart, but I have no choice. Can't you understand that?'. And I say  'no! No! I can't understand that!'.

session_7.speaker: David
session_7.text: Uh, ow.

session_7.speaker: Fiona
session_7.text: Ooh, sorry. Um, and, and then you put your arms around me. And then you put your arms around me.  And, um, and then you tell me that you love me and you'll never forget me.

session_7.text: I'll never forget you.

session_7.text: And then you say that it's almost midnight and you have to go because you don't wanna start the new year with me if you can't finish it.  I'm gonna miss you. You scientist guy.

session_7.text: I dunno. I don't feel like kissing anyone tonight.

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Nonono, you can't kiss Bennett, that's your brother.

session_7.speaker: Bennett
session_7.text: Perfect. Perfect. So now everybody's getting kissed but me.

session_7.speaker: Dexter
session_7.text: Alright, somebody kiss me. Somebody kiss me, it's midnight! Somebody kiss me!

session_7.speaker: Ethan
session_7.text: Alrightalrightalright.  There.

session_8.speaker: Bennett
session_8.text: I wanted this to work so much. I mean I'm still in there, changing his diapers, pickin' his fleas... but he's just phoning it in. Just so hard to accept the fact that something you love so much doesn't love you back.

session_8.speaker: Ariel
